name: first-customer-finder
title_zh: 从公开抱怨里挖出第一批付费种子用户
tagline_zh: 别再用行业报告猜客户了。它扫 Reddit、HN、推文里的真实痛点和购买信号，按适配度和时机给潜在用户排序。
tagline_en: Stop guessing who your first users are. It scans Reddit, HN, and tweets for real pain and buying signals, ranks.
desc_en: Find and qualify evidence-backed potential first customers, early adopters, design partners, or beta users for a startup using recent public pain and buying signals. Use when Codex needs to analyze a product URL or idea, define an ideal customer profile, research public discussions and business pages, identify first-user prospects, rank lead fit and timing, prepare source-based outreach drafts, or
why_zh: 不靠泛泛的 ICP 画像，而是把公开讨论里的抱怨、预算线索和近期行为交叉验证，用证据链而非直觉给线索打。
why_en: Instead of generic ICP profiles, it cross-references complaints, budget hints, and recent behavior from public posts to score.
limit_zh: 只认英文公开文本（Reddit/HN/推特/博客），不碰 LinkedIn 私域和付费数据库；产出到'带出处的线索列表。
limit_en: English public text only (Reddit/HN/Twitter/blogs); no LinkedIn or paid DBs. Output ends at sourced lead list + outreach draft; no auto-sending or.
